title: Plurai wants to help AI agents work better using the same approach that helped get self-driving cars to roads | TechCrunch
summary: Now, a startup known as Plurai wants to boost those numbers with the same techniques that put self-driving cars on the street: Simulations using synthetic data based on a company’s own digital systems, meant to prepare models to tackle difficult edge cases.
